&=\lim_{\tau\to\infty}\frac{1}{\tau}\left[\sum_i m_i\dot{\mathbf r}_i\cdot\mathbf r_i\right]_{0}^{\tau}=0,
\end{aligned}
}
\]

since the quantity remains finite (and is periodic when the motion is periodic). Therefore,
\[
\boxed{\overline{T}=-\frac12\overline{\sum_i\mathbf F_i\cdot\mathbf r_i}}.
\]

For \(V(r)=C/r\),
\[
\mathbf F=-\nabla V=\frac{C}{r^3}\mathbf r,
\qquad
\mathbf F\cdot\mathbf r=\frac{C}{r}=V.
\]
Hence,
\[
\boxed{\overline{T}=-\frac{\overline{V}}{2}}.
\]
